principle.id: Nilai menilai proses, bukan untung atau rugi. Proses yang benar tetap bernilai baik walaupun kena SL; proses yang salah tidak mendapat nilai tambahan karena kebetulan untung.
principle.en: The score judges the process, never the profit or loss. A sound process still scores well when it hits the SL; a poor one earns nothing extra for a lucky profit.

risk.measure: risk_pct = |entry − SL| in pips × pip value per lot (USD) × lot ÷ balance × 100

volatility_part.measure: sl_atr = |entry − SL| ÷ ATR(14) at Start (key: numbers.atr14_pips)

bonus.when: SL beyond numbers.invalidation_level (or no level given)

reasons.rule: 6 × (valid reasons chosen ÷ reasons chosen); 0 with no reason

cases.case: ran to SL, TP or the window's auto-close
manual close with a valid close reason (structure_broken, news_ahead, target_area)
manual close before the target without a valid reason (small_profit, bored)
panic close near the SL without a new signal (fear)

scenario_no_trade.rule: When decision.ideal is no_trade the whole score is decision and reasons.

pending_unfilled.rule: A pending order that never fills is scored on the decision only: decision points × 5 (out of 100); lot, SL and TP aren't scored.

mcq_complex.rule: Per option: +1 ÷ k for each right option chosen, −1 ÷ k for each wrong option chosen (k = number of right options); floor 0, max 1.

report.id: Hasil akhir berupa umpan balik per aspek (risiko, SL, TP/R:R, keputusan, manajemen posisi) dan level Learn 101 yang perlu diulang, dihitung dari soal PG yang salah per level. Tanpa peringkat dan tanpa perbandingan antar pengguna.
report.en: The result is feedback per aspect (risk, SL, TP/R:R, decision, position management) and the Learn 101 levels to revisit, from the wrong answers per level. No ranking and no comparison between users.

decision.id: Hasil pemilu presiden adalah peristiwa besar yang hasilnya belum diketahui dan dirilis bertahap sepanjang malam. Spread bisa melebar dan harga bisa melompat melewati SL. Sikap yang disarankan Level 5 untuk pemula adalah menghindar atau menunggu sesudahnya. Struktur M15 sebelum Mulai juga campuran, jadi tidak ada keunggulan arah yang jelas.
decision.en: A presidential election is a major event with an unknown result that arrives piece by piece through the night. Spreads can widen and price can jump past an SL. The approach Level 5 recommends for beginners is to stay out or wait for afterwards. The M15 structure before Start is mixed too, so there's no clear directional edge.

name.id: Bank of Canada memangkas suku bunga secara mengejutkan
name.en: Bank of Canada's surprise rate cut

decision.id: Struktur M15 naik sesudah pemangkasan bunga, dan bank sentral yang melonggarkan cenderung melemahkan mata uangnya (CAD). Setelah lonjakan besar, yang dicari adalah buy di area pullback lewat pending buy limit, bukan mengejar harga. NO TRADE pun masih bisa diterima karena volatilitas sesudah kejutan masih tinggi.
decision.en: The M15 structure is rising after the rate cut, and a central bank that eases tends to weaken its currency (CAD). After a big spike, the setup is a buy in the pullback area via a pending buy limit, not chasing price. NO TRADE is acceptable too, with volatility still high after the surprise.

decision.id: Struktur M15 sesudah kabar itu turun, dan AUD terkait erat dengan permintaan dari Tiongkok. Sell searah struktur dengan SL di atas lower high terakhir masuk akal; karena volatilitas masih tinggi, lot harus dihitung dari jarak SL yang lebih lebar. decision.en: The M15 structure after the news is falling, and AUD is closely tied to demand from China. A sell with the structure and an SL above the last lower high makes sense; with volatility still high, the lot has to come from a wider SL. Level 4 (when not to enter) and Level 5 (high-impact news) both say to wait until the release has passed and spreads are normal, then judge the reaction. Opening now means carrying slippage and whipsaw risk without a plan.

explanation.id: Ask adalah harga beli dari pasar, bid adalah harga jual ke pasar; selisihnya spread.
explanation.en: The ask is what you pay to buy, the bid is what you get when you sell; the difference is the spread.

explanation.id: 1 lot EUR/USD = $10 per pip, jadi 0,3 lot = $3 per pip; 20 pip × $3 = $60.
explanation.en: 1 lot of EUR/USD = $10 per pip, so 0.3 lot = $3 per pip; 20 pips × $3 = $60.

explanation.id: Badan hijau: open di bawah, close di atas.
explanation.en: A green body: open at the bottom, close at the top.

explanation.id: Hammer berbentuk seperti palu dan menandakan potensi pembalikan naik; potensi, bukan kepastian.
explanation.en: A hammer signals a possible turn higher; a possibility, not a certainty.

explanation.id: Swing high dengan n = 2 butuh pola lima candle dengan candle tengah paling tinggi.
explanation.en: A swing high with n = 2 needs a five-candle pattern with the middle candle highest.
Drawdown is measured from the peak: 3,000 ÷ 15,000 = 20%.

explanation.id: Idealnya akun tidak pernah sampai stop out karena stop loss yang benar sudah menutup posisi jauh sebelumnya.
explanation.en: Ideally an account never reaches a stop out, because a proper stop loss has closed the position long before.

explanation.id: Breakout valid: close di luar level dan bertahan. False breakout: menembus lalu kembali ke dalam range.
explanation.en: A valid breakout closes beyond the level and holds. A false breakout pokes through, then returns inside the range.

explanation.id: Kabar yang sudah diperkirakan tidak banyak menggerakkan harga; yang menggerakkan adalah kejutan.
explanation.en: News that was expected barely moves price; surprises do.

explanation.id: Core CPI lebih menggambarkan tekanan harga yang menetap; ukuran resmi target The Fed adalah PCE.
explanation.en: Core CPI better reflects persistent price pressure; the Fed's official target measure is PCE.

explanation.id: Kalau titik masuk dalam rencana sudah lewat, jangan masuk dengan harga lain; pasar akan menyediakan setup baru.
explanation.en: If the planned entry has passed, don't enter at another price; the market will offer a new setup.

explanation.id: Pelanggaran bisa menutupi kualitas strategi; dengan memisahkan, sumber masalahnya terlihat.
explanation.en: Rule breaks can hide a strategy's quality; separating them shows where the problem really is.
